## Creating a Landing Page with Froala Tables and Pre-Made Elements


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000043444

Follow the instructions below to learn how to create a landing page that looks like this:

1. Create a new static page. Click on this article for more information >> How to Create a New Static Page

2. Add a single row using the table option in the Froala Editor . Add background color and text as desired. In this example, we have used different font sizes of 22 and 16, respectively; also some words are bold:

3. Drag and drop the pre-made element "Text with Image Left" into the static page:

4. Add the image and text as needed:

5. Edit the button text and link:

6. Save the changes:

You can also create this page using our integrated AI solutions. See: 1. BD Butler 2. Quick Create Wizard - Create Web Page
